query: SELECT strftime(date_trunc('month', date), '%Y-%m') AS month, count(DISTINCT tx_hash) AS txs FROM (SELECT date, tx_hash FROM (SELECT date, tx_hash, script_hash AS h FROM transaction_scripts WHERE date in <year window> UNION ALL SELECT date, tx_hash, owner_payment_credential AS h FROM address_utxo WHERE date >= DATE '2021-09-01' AND date < DATE '2022-01-01') WHERE h IN ('0c70d8047139103546f0e76aafecfdf0667cbb397c8976f40ae8fcb3', '28bbd1f7aebb3bc59e13597f333aeefb8f5ab78eda962de1d605b388', '4ab17afc9a19a4f06b6fe229f9501e727d3968bff03acb1a8f86acf5', 'ab658d65b5717bf07bd3b1a9ad28d31c183811bba4076aeace9feb8e')) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
